mapper.select:
select p.PL_Name as plName, c.C_Name as cName,
from SYS_User u left join SYS_PositionLV p on u.PL_ID=p.PL_ID left join SYS_Company c on u.C_ID=c.C_ID
u.U_Id in
#{uId}

select c.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c.C_Name as cName, c.C_CreditCode as cCreditCode, c.c_type as cType,
from SYS_User u left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=u.C_ID where u.U_Id=#{uId}

where.if: and exists ( select 1 from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pup.PP_ID = pp.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on pp.PD_ID = dp.PD_ID where pup.U_Id = u.U_Id and dp.PD_Type = #{params.pdType} )

and exists ( select 1 from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pup.PP_ID = pp.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on pp.PD_ID = dp.PD_ID where pup.U_Id = u.U_Id and dp.PD_Code = #{params.pdCode} )

and exists ( select 1 from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pup.PP_ID = pp.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on pp.PD_ID = dp.PD_ID where pup.U_Id = u.U_Id and dp.P_Id = #{params.projectId} )

mapper.select: select count(*) from SYS_User u left join SYS_PositionLV p on u.PL_ID=p.PL_ID left join SYS_Company c on u.C_ID=c.C_ID
mapper.sql: (select group_concat(distinct dp.PD_Code order by dp.PD_Code separator ',') from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.PP_ID = pup.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID = pp.PD_ID where pup.U_ID = u.U_ID and dp.PD_Code is not null) as pdCode,

(select group_concat(distinct dp.PD_Code order by dp.PD_Code separator ',') from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.PP_ID = pup.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID = pp.PD_ID where pup.U_ID = u.U_ID and dp.PD_Code is not null) as pdCode,

( select LISTAGG(t.PD_Code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.PD_Code) from ( select distinct dp.PD_Code from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.PP_ID = pup.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID = pp.PD_ID where pup.U_ID = u.U_ID and dp.PD_Code is not null ) t ) as pdCode,

( select string_agg(t.PD_Code, ',' order by t.PD_Code) from ( select distinct dp.PD_Code from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.PP_ID = pup.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID = pp.PD_ID where pup.U_ID = u.U_ID and dp.PD_Code is not null ) t ) as pdCode,
mapper.select: select count(*) from SYS_User u left join SYS_PositionLV p on u.PL_ID=p.PL_ID left join SYS_Company c on u.C_ID=c.C_ID

select count(*) from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User pu on u.U_ID=pu.U_ID left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_ID=p.P_ID left join SYS_Department d on d.D_ID=p.D_ID left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=u.C_ID left join SYS_PositionLV plv on plv.PL_ID=u.PL_ID where 1=1

select pro.p_Project_Stage as pProjectStage, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pup.PUP_ID as pupId, dp.PD_ID as pdId, dp.PD_Name as pdName, dp.PD_Code as pdCode, pp.PP_Name as ppName, pp.PP_Code as ppCode, pp.PP_ID as ppId,
from SYS_Position_User_P pup left join Sys_User u on u.U_Id=pup.U_Id left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.PP_ID=pup.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID=pp.PD_ID left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=dp.P_ID
and u.Te_ID=#{params.teId}
and dp.PD_ID=#{params.pdId}
and u.U_ID=#{params.uId}
and INSTR(dp.PD_Name,#{params.pdName})
and INSTR(dp.PD_Code,#{params.pdCode})
and INSTR(pp.PP_Name,#{params.ppName})
and INSTR(pp.PP_Code,#{params.ppCode})
and INSTR(u.U_Name,#{params.uName})
and INSTR(u.U_Account,#{params.uAccount})
and likePname(#{params.pName},pro.P_Id)=true
and INSTR(pro.P_Name,#{params.pName})
and INSTR(pro.P_Code,#{params.pCode})

select p.PP_ID as ppId, p.PD_ID as pdId, p.PP_Name as ppName, c.C_Name as cName, c.C_Type as cType, plv.PL_Name as plName, d.PD_Name as pdName, d.PD_Code as pdCode, pu.Pup_Id as pupId, pu.Pup_Sort as pupSort, pro.P_Name as projectName,
from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User_P pu on u.U_ID=pu.U_ID left join SYS_Position_P p on pu.PP_ID=p.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P d on d.PD_ID=p.PD_ID left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=u.C_ID left join SYS_PositionLV plv on plv.PL_ID=u.PL_ID left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id= d.P_Id
order by u.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by pu.Pup_Sort asc
order by u.U_sort asc
order by u.U_CreateTime DESC
mapper.sql: u.U_ID as uId, u.PL_ID as plID, u.C_ID as cID, u.U_Name as uName, u.U_Code as uCode, u.U_MTel as uMtel, u.U_Tel as uTel, u.U_Email as uEmail, u.U_Account as uAccount, u.U_PassWord as uPassword, u.U_Sex as uSex, u.U_Birthday as uBirthday, u.U_State as uState, u.U_MDM_NO as uMdmNo, u.U_CreateTime as uCreatetime, u.U_CreateU_ID as uCreateuID, u.U_CreateU_Name as uCreateuName, u.U_Type as uType, u.U_Office as uOffice, u.U_Cornet as uCornet, u.U_IdCard as uIdcard, u.U_Sort as uSort, u.U_Push_Id as uPushId, u.Open_Id as openId, u.U_Signature as uSignature, u.U_Qualification as uQualification, u.sign as sign, u.u_class as uClass, u.u_key as uKey
mapper.select: select TABLE_NAME from all_tab_columns where table_name IN (select TABLE_NAME from dba_tables) and COLUMN_NAME = 'Con_Id';

select count(*) from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User_P up on up.U_ID=u.U_ID left join SYS_Position_P pp on up.PP_ID=pp.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID=pp.PD_ID where dp.P_Id=#{pId} and pp.PP_Name in
#{posName}

select u.* from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User_P up on up.U_ID=u.U_ID left join SYS_Position_P pp on up.PP_ID=pp.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P dp on dp.PD_ID=pp.PD_ID where dp.P_Id=#{pId} and pp.PP_Name in
#{posName}

select mn.*, c.C_Name as cName from SYS_User mn left join SYS_Position_User pu on mn.U_ID=pu.U_ID left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_ID=p.P_ID left join SYS_Company c on mn.C_ID=c.C_ID where p.P_Name in
#{posName}

select MAX(p.PP_ID) as ppId, MAX(p.PD_ID) as pdId, MAX(p.PP_Name) as ppName, MAX(c.C_Name) as cName, MAX(c.C_Type) as cType, MAX(plv.PL_Name) as plName, MAX(d.PD_Name) as pdName, MAX(pu.Pup_Id) as pupId, MAX(pu.Pup_Sort) as pupSort, MAX(pro.P_Name) as projectName,
from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User_P pu on u.U_ID=pu.U_ID left join SYS_Position_P p on pu.PP_ID=p.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P d on d.PD_ID=p.PD_ID left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=u.C_ID left join SYS_PositionLV plv on plv.PL_ID=u.PL_ID left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id= d.P_Id
GROUP BY u.U_ID, u.PL_ID, u.C_ID, u.U_Name, u.U_Code, u.U_MTel, u.U_Tel, u.U_Email, u.U_Account, u.U_PassWord, u.U_Sex, u.U_Birthday, u.U_State, u.U_MDM_NO, u.U_CreateTime, u.U_CreateU_ID, u.U_CreateU_Name, u.U_Type, u.U_Office, u.U_Cornet, u.U_IdCard, u.U_Sort, u.U_Push_Id, u.Open_Id, u.U_Signature, u.U_Qualification, u.sign, u.u_class, u.u_key
order by u.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by pu.Pup_Sort asc
order by u.U_sort asc
order by u.U_CreateTime DESC
